About Nexfil USA

Nexfil USA is a professional window film manufacturer headquartered in Gardena, California. The company produces a full architectural line — sputter metalized, nano-ceramic, carbon color-stable, silver reflective, safety, anti-graffiti, and decorative films — engineered for U.S. climate conditions including the extreme heat and UV load of the Arizona Southwest.

Arizona House of Film is an authorized Nexfil distributor and installer. We stock the highest-volume OnyVa IR90 and Lux IR80 SKUs in Phoenix for same-week residential and commercial installation, and order-in the full catalog with 1–2 week lead time directly from Gardena.

Frequently Asked Questions — Nexfil Window Film

What is Nexfil OnyVa IR90?

OnyVa IR90 is Nexfil USA’s flagship nano-ceramic film with 90% IR (infrared) rejection — among the highest in the architectural film market. It is non-metallic, so it does not interfere with GPS, cellular, WiFi, or Bluetooth signals. OnyVa is offered in VLT levels from 5% to 70%, so you can pick the exact darkness while keeping the same 90% IR performance. In Arizona heat, OnyVa IR90 70% is the nearly-invisible option, and 20–35% VLT are the most-specified residential and commercial choices.

How does Nexfil compare to LLumar and Hüper Optik?

All three are professional architectural film manufacturers. Nexfil OnyVa IR90 rejects 90% of IR — comparable to Hüper Optik Ceramic and LLumar IRX at a better wholesale price point, which is why we specify it on cost-sensitive commercial jobs. Hüper Optik still leads on optical neutrality for high-end residential, and LLumar has broader NFRC rebate documentation coverage. For most Arizona projects, the three lines are interchangeable by spec — Arizona House of Film picks based on availability, price, and rebate eligibility.

Is Nexfil available for same-week installation in Phoenix?

Most Nexfil architectural SKUs ship from Gardena, California in 1–2 weeks. We stock the highest-volume OnyVa IR90 and Lux IR80 rolls in Phoenix, so same-week installation is routine for those SKUs. Specialty colors, non-stocked VLT levels, and safety films 7 mil and above are order-in only. We confirm lead time for your selected SKU during the free on-site estimate.

What is the difference between Lux IR80 and OnyVa IR90?

Both are non-metallic nano-ceramic films with no signal interference. Lux IR80 rejects 80% of IR and is the value-tier nano-ceramic option — it works well on interior rooms and north/east exposures where heat load is moderate. OnyVa IR90 rejects 90% of IR (a 10-point jump) and is the premium nano-ceramic — the right spec for west- and south-facing glass in Phoenix where IR load is at its worst. OnyVa also holds TSER performance better across the VLT range.

Does Arizona House of Film install Nexfil film?

Yes. Arizona House of Film is an authorized Nexfil USA distributor and installer. Every install is performed by our W-2 crews under Arizona ROC #314088. We carry the full Nexfil architectural line — OnyVa IR90, Lux IR80, Centurion and HP Centurion carbon, Solar Bronze, Elegance, Prestigious Silver, Twilight dual reflective, Silver Reflective 05–50%, Safety Film 2–12 mil, Anti-Graffiti 4 mil, and the decorative range (Blackout, Whiteout, White Frost, Silver Matte).
